thread:
Nora Patel: Kicking off MarlinHealth onboarding. Need to align stakeholders, SSO, data scope, and a 0-30 day plan. Propose Tue 4/6 10am PT for a 30m kickoff. Agenda: owners, infra access, pilot metrics, blockers.

Owen Reed: Tue 10am works. Quick Q: MarlinHealth on Private or Hosted? affects networking.

Marin Solis (MarlinHealth): Private (VPC). SOC2 and HIPAA both in scope. We'll seed with ~15k support articles.

Ava Brooks: I'll own enablement + prompt workshop. Nora, I'll prepare a pre-kick checklist (SSO metadata, sample docs, contact list).

Nora Patel: Draft success criteria: 1) endpoint reachable from Marlin VPC + auth, 2) ingest 15k docs and searchable, 3) pilot NPS >= 4/5 week 2, 4) latency p95 < 300ms in staging. Edit as needed.

Marin Solis (MarlinHealth): Add PHI scoping pass from legal before go-live.

Owen Reed: For infra I'll need allowlist + Okta metadata by Mon. I'll propose a small Dedicated reserve for first 30 days.

Nora Patel: Owner matrix: Marlin exec: Marin; Tech lead: TBD; CSM: Nora; Solutions: Ava; Infra: Owen.

Ava Brooks: I'll draft a 90-min enablement + evaluation session for week 2 and attach prompt set.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: "MarlinHealth Onboard Kickoff" Tue Apr 6 10:00am PT 	 invite sent. Link: https://meet.redwood.ai/meet/marlin-0406

Nora Patel: Blockers to track: legal PHI checklist, network allowlist, sample docs upload. I'll post a 0-30 owner timeline here by EOD.

Marin Solis (MarlinHealth): We'll get Okta admin + sample docs (2k) to you by Mon EOD.

Owen Reed: I'll post firewall rules + capacity estimate after samples.

Nora Patel: Thanks all  see you Tue.
